capabilities: Assign a distinct color to each heading level from a built-in colormap
Set per-level font and background colors, bold, and italic
Tune palette size, font opacity, and background opacity
Toggle coloring separately in the editor and reading view
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian renders all heading levels with the same styling, so heading hierarchy is hard to distinguish at a glance.

relations.evidence: Scaffolded from the obsidian-sample-plugin template by Obsidian

summary: Header colorizer that gives H1-H6 headings customizable font and background colors in the editor and reading view, via colormaps or per-level settings.
